title: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
CODE OF CIVIL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th January, 1990]
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Code of Civil Procedure
(Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Civil Procedure Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Amendment of First Schedule, Act V of 1908

ACT IV OF 1990
ACT IV OF 1990
CODE OF CIVIL
PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th January, 1990]
2. Amendment of First
Schedule, Act V of 1908: -In the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act V of
1908), in the First Schedule,--
(a) in Order
XXII, in rule 9, after sub-rule (2), the following new sub- rule shall be
added, namely:--
"(3). The
provisions of section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1908 (IX of 1908), shall apply
to applications under sub-rule (2).";
(b) in Order
XLI,--
(i) rule 19
shall be re-numbered as sub-rule (1) of that rule and, after sub-rule (1)
re-numbered as aforesaid, the following new sub-rule shall be added, namely:--
"(2). The provisions of
section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1908 (IX of 1908), shall apply to an
application for re-admission of an appeal dismissed under sub -rule (2) of rule
11 or sub-rule (1) of rule 17."; and
(ii) rule 21
shall be re-numbered as sub-rule (1) of that rule and, after sub-rule (1)
re-numbered as aforesaid, the following new sub-rule shall be added, namely:--
"(2) The provisions of section 5 of the Limitation Act,
1908 (IX of 1908), shall apply to applications under sub-rule (1)."
